problems: Alumni page vs rosters: the alumni page lists Brenton Pennicooke as a 2018 graduate and Ibrahim Hussain as 2019, but the rosters list Pennicooke PGY-7 in 2018-19 (Oct 2018 - Mar 2019) and Hussain PGY-7 in 2019-20 (Jul-Dec 2019); rosters loaded as observed, alumni years inserted as stated. Rafael Uribe (2019 intern) jumped PGY-3 (2021-22) to PGY-5 (2022-23) and graduated 2025 with the 2018 entrants: an acceleration, not a transfer. Class sizes of 3 in 2013 (Hussain, Link, Rapoport) and 2019 (Garton, Giantini Larsen, Uribe). Common Crawl not run: no year missing. No Columbia (program 48) names involved. Phase 2: training_history alumni rows for Pennicooke (2018) and Hussain (2019) left as the alumni page states; their PGY-7 year was an enfolded fellowship and training ended the following June.
